# Samsaadhanii source data — 1000 Sentences e-reader (complete dump)

Every record retrieved from the Samsaadhanii e-reader data files, rendered
verbatim in Markdown. Nothing has been filtered, corrected, recomposed, or
translated. The companion app (1000 Sentences e-reader, `index.html`)
renders a subset of these fields; this file is the full retrieved dataset,
for reference and reuse.

## Provenance

- **Source:** the public data directory of the Samsaadhanii e-reader,
  `https://ereaders.samsaadhanii.in/books/data/books/1000%20Sentences/`
- **Retrieved:** 11 November 2026, by direct download of the JSON files
  from the public Apache listing. No login, no API key, no scraping of
  rendered pages. (An earlier 7 November snapshot of the rendered site,
  used for the first 100 sentences, was cross-checked against this
  download with zero differences.)
- **Files retrieved:** `analysis.json`, `slokas.json`, `chapters.json`.
- **Credit:** analysis by the Samsaadhanii e-reader, Computational
  Linguistics Group, University of Hyderabad, developed under the guidance
  of Prof. Amba Kulkarni. Used with her permission (granted 14 Nov 2026),
  with attribution, non-commercially. See `README.md`.

## Inventory (verified by counting this dump)

- **analysis.json:** 5718 records, 25 fields each;
  all carry `book` = 1000 Sentences.
- **slokas.json:** 997 entries = 996 sentences + 1 stale duplicate
  (see below). Every entry has at least one analysis record, and every
  record group has a matching entry — there are no orphans either way.
- **Sentences:** 996, numbered 1–999. Gaps preserved: Nos. 3, 825, and 895
  do not exist in the source, and there is no No. 1000 (Chapter 20 ends
  at 999). Nothing was invented to fill the gaps.
- **Placeholder rows:** 819 rows in `analysis.json` are placeholders,
  not words: rows whose `word` is `.` or `-` with all analysis fields
  `-`. They are included verbatim below; the app's extractor excludes
  them. 460 carry `word` = `.`, 359 carry `word` = `-`.
- **Stale duplicate:** chaptno `1` (unpadded) holds 10 records for
  slokano `024` — a stale duplicate of sentence 24, including 9
  non-placeholder records and differing Hindi/possible_relations values.
  The padded `01` version is authoritative; the app excludes the duplicate.
  It is included below, flagged, so the dump is complete.
- **Real word records:** 5718 − 819 placeholders − 9
  stale-duplicate records = 4890 words across
  the 996 sentences. This matches the app's extracted word count exactly.
- **Records with no graph** (`graph` = `-`): 63. Seven sentences
  have no source graph at all: 24, 72, 524, 540, 654, 893, 917.

## Field glossary (analysis.json records)

| Field | Meaning | Notes in this export |
|---|---|---|
| `_id` | Source database id | Unique per record. |
| `chaptno` | Chapter number | `01`–`20`, plus the stale duplicate under unpadded `1`. |
| `slokano` | Sentence number within the chapter | Zero-padded (`001`–`050`). No merged entries: every entry is exactly one sentence. |
| `sentno` | Sentence number within the entry | Always `1`. |
| `bgcolor` | Highlight colour of the word in the e-reader | Presentation only. |
| `graph` | Relative path of the pre-rendered karaka-graph SVG | `assets/graphs/<ch>_<n>_1.svg`, or `-` where the source has no graph. The paths are names only — no static graph files exist at any public URL; the e-reader draws graphs at runtime from the relation data. |
| `anvaya_no` | Sentence-order pada index | e.g. `2.1`. |
| `word` | Pada form | A trailing `-` marks the first part of a compound/sandhi split; parentheses mark words supplied by the analysis, e.g. `(त्वम्)`; `.` and `-` rows are placeholders (see Inventory). |
| `poem` | Prose/anvaya-order position | `-` where the word has no prose position (supplied/implied words). |
| `sandhied_word` | Surface form as it appears in the sentence | `-` for sub-words and supplied words. |
| `morph_analysis` | Morphological analysis | |
| `morph_in_context` | Morphology as used in this sentence | The field the app displays. |
| `kaaraka_sambandha` | Karaka relation + head index | e.g. `कर्ता,4.1`; `-` where absent. The displayed relation. |
| `possible_relations` | Other candidate relations | `#`-separated; `-` where none. The app shows these as alternate relations. |
| `hindi_meaning` | Hindi gloss | `_`-joined in the source; `-` where absent. The app shows Hindi with spaces. |
| `english_meaning` | English gloss | `-` for every record in this export (unpopulated). The app's English glosses are short learner renderings written for the app, not source data and not copied from any dictionary. |
| `samAsa` | Compound (samasa) analysis | `-` for every record (unpopulated). |
| `prayoga` | Prayoga (voice) | `-` for every record (unpopulated). |
| `sarvanAma` | Pronoun classification | `-` for every record (unpopulated). |
| `name_classification` | Name classification | `-` for every record (unpopulated). |
| `book` | Source book | `1000 Sentences` for every record. |
| `part1`, `part2` | Unused | `null` for every record. |
| `__v` | Source version key | `0` for every record. |
| `meanings` | Glosses by language | Object with a single key `ta` (Tamil); non-empty for 0 of 5718 records. |

## Reading notes

- `-` is the source's own marker for "absent". It is preserved, never
  replaced with a guess.
- `slokas.json` entries carry `chaptno`, `slokano`, `spart1`, `spart2`
  (both always empty — legacy fields) and `sparts`, the array of sentence
  lines (one line per sentence here). The sentence text below is the
  `sparts` array joined in order, stripped of leading/trailing whitespace
  (52 entries carry a leading space in the source).
- Section headings show the source key (`chaptno.slokano`) and the app's
  sentence number (No. 1–999). The stale duplicate is flagged in its
  heading.
- Record order within each entry follows the source file order,
  placeholders included.
